title: NCO
text: Generate real or complex sinusoidal signals, 5 inputs, 3 outputs, {Type of output signal} sets Format of output waveform; {Phase increment source} sets the source of phase increment, {Phase increment}, {Phase offset source} sets the source of phase offset, {Phase offset}, {Dither source} sets the source of number of dither, {Number of dither bits} sets the bits used to express dither, {Samples per frame} sets the vector size for frame-based input, {Enable look up table compression method} sets the compress the lookup table, {Enable accumulator reset input port} enables reset control signal, {Enable phase port} sets the output current phase, {Rounding Mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations, {Overflow mode}, {Accumulator Data Type} sets the accumulator data type Binary, {Accumulator Signed} sets the signed or unsigned accumulator data format, {Accumulator Word length}, {Accumulator Fraction length}, {Quantize phase} sets the quantize accumulated phase, {Number of quantizer accumulator bits}, {Output Data Type} sets the output data type Binary, {Output Signed} sets the signed or unsigned output data format, {Output Word length} and {Output Fraction length}. Values come from the instance.
